input: Write a due diligence memo on Canva

business.claim: As_of 2026-11-10: Canva offers an online visual-creation suite covering presentations, documents, spreadsheets, websites, social content, photo/video editing and AI-assisted design, serving individuals, educators and businesses.

As_of 2026-11-10: Freemium subscription model. Displayed US annual pricing is $144 for Pro and $250 per person for Business; Enterprise requires contacting sales. Additional AI allowances are monetized through add-ons and top-ups.
Company claim, observed 2026-11-10: Canva's undated About page lists availability in 190 countries and more than 100 languages; these figures have no stated measurement date.

traction.claim: Company claim, as_of 2025-12-31: >265M monthly active users; >31M paid users.

Company claim, observed 2026-11-10: Canva says it is used by 95% of the Fortune 500 and names FedEx, Salesforce, Expedia, Reddit, Docusign and Zoom as Enterprise users. This is not a disclosed count of paid enterprise contracts.

Company claim, observed 2026-11-10: A Stripe case study reports 20x greater content production and campaign launches shortened from months to days using Canva Enterprise. The outcome measurement period is unspecified.
Company claim, observed 2026-11-10: Canva describes integrations enabling design generation, editing and preview inside ChatGPT, plus a Canva plugin for Codex; commercial terms are not disclosed.

team.claim: As_of 2026-11-10: Canva identifies Melanie Perkins as co-founder and CEO in its workforce-restructuring announcement.
As_of 2026-11-10: Canva's official author biography identifies Cliff Obrecht as co-founder and COO.
As_of 2026-11-10: Canva's official author biography identifies Cameron Adams as co-founder and chief product officer.
Historical company account, accessed 2026-11-10: Perkins and Obrecht previously launched school-yearbook design business Fusion Books; Adams previously worked as a lead designer at Google.
Aggregator data, updated 2026-09-18: The Official Board identifies Kelly Steckelberg as current CFO, says she joined Canva in 2024 and previously served as Zoom's CFO.

As_of 2026-05-01: Canva confirmed to SmartCompany that CTO Brendan Humphreys would step down in June and remain an adviser. Simon Newton, previously at Google and Uber, would become head of technology rather than directly replacing the CTO title.

funding.claim: Company announcement, as_of 2021-09-15: Raised US$200 million at a US$40 billion valuation, led by T. Rowe Price. Participants included Franklin Templeton, Sequoia Capital Global Equities, Bessemer, Greenoaks, Dragoneer, Blackbird, Felicis and AirTree.

Reuters reported, as_of 2025-08-20: Canva launched an employee share sale at a $42 billion valuation, led by Fidelity Management, with JPMorgan Asset Management joining. This was secondary shareholder liquidity, not equivalent to new operating capital; share-sale size was undisclosed.

Investor disclosure, transaction dated 2026-06-24: Robinhood Ventures Fund I purchased approximately $25 million of Canva Class A common stock. The announcement does not establish the transaction valuation or whether Canva received primary proceeds.

Forbes reported on 2026-09-18 that Blackbird marked Canva to US$34.9 billion. At 2026-06-30, T. Rowe Price and Franklin Templeton implied US$38.2 billion and US$39.3 billion, respectively. These are investor marks, not newly priced financing rounds.

financial_signals.claim: Company claim for 2025, accessed 2026-11-10: Canva's annual recap reports $3.5 billion in revenue. The page does not specify currency, accounting basis or an audit opinion.

Sacra estimate, as_of 2026-10-31: $3.7 billion ARR, down 7.5% from $4 billion at 2025 year-end. This is third-party research/aggregator data, not independently verified current company financial reporting.

Forbes reported on 2026-09-18 that Canva told investors in July its expected 2026 revenue growth had fallen from 30% to 20%, alongside AI-cost-related product delays. This is a forecast revision, not a reported annual result.

Company claim, observed 2026-11-10: Restructuring affects 1,271 people, or 22% of the workforce, through departures, role changes and relocation. This is not confirmation of 1,271 redundancies. Product, Growth and Platform are being combined, with fewer management layers.
Historical headcount, as_of 2024-08: The Information reported approximately 4,600 employees, up 1,000 from the preceding August. This is not a current workforce count.

legal_and_regulatory.claim: ASIC reported that Canva Pty Ltd paid A$198,000 for alleged late FY2024 reporting: the report was due 2025-04-30 and lodged 2026-03-27. Payment was not an admission of liability or conviction. ASIC also confirmed FY2025 reporting under the restructured Australian reporting entity was lodged 2026-04-30.

Historical company disclosure, accessed 2026-11-10: The 2019-05-24 breach exposed profile information for up to 139 million users and hashed passwords. By 2020-01-11, Canva knew approximately 4 million affected accounts' passwords had been decrypted and shared online.

As_of 2026-08-26: Plaintiff law firm Migliaccio & Rathod announced an investigation into whether uploaded Canva content was used for AI development without adequately informed consent. The page announces a law-firm investigation, not a regulator finding or court-filed complaint.
A federal order dated 2024-04-03 records Accessify's patent action against Canva, Inc. and Canva Pty Ltd, filed 2023-10-23, and Canva, Inc.'s voluntary dismissal from that action on 2024-03-29.

Aggregator data, case outcome dated 2024-11-12: Patsnap records the remaining Accessify litigation as closed following dismissal with prejudice. The underlying closure order was not independently opened.

Historical company claim, undated page accessed 2026-11-10: Canva announced withdrawal from Russia, blocking access and ceasing payments in the region. This announcement does not independently establish current sanctions exposure or compliance.

reputation.claim: Employee-review aggregator snapshot, as_of 2026-11-10: Glassdoor displayed 3.8/5 across 923 reviews, 71% recommending Canva and 3.1/5 for senior management. Visible recent reviews praise colleagues but criticize leadership, bureaucracy and organizational changes; these are anonymous opinions, not verified findings.

Customer-review aggregator snapshot, as_of 2026-11-10: Trustpilot displayed 4.0/5 across 8,318 reviews, with 29% one-star. Visible complaints concern AI/content limits, renewal refunds and print consistency; positive reviews praise usability and support. Canva invites reviews, limiting representativeness.

Critical press, as_of 2026-08-18: Inc. reported stagnating user growth and higher AI-serving costs, particularly among free users. Canva and its investors defended a long-term AI strategy and reported progress reducing serving costs.

red_flags.claim: Assessment as_of 2026-11-10: Reported AI-cost-related rollout delays and reduced revenue-growth expectations warrant direct testing of inference costs, free-user economics and paid conversion.
Assessment as_of 2026-11-10: The company-confirmed restructuring creates execution and retention risk while changing product ownership, management layers and team locations.
Assessment as_of 2026-11-10: The documented reporting delay raises a financial-control diligence issue, although ASIC confirms subsequent annual reporting was lodged on time.
Assessment as_of 2026-11-10: Investor markdowns make the historical employee-sale valuation an unsafe standalone benchmark for current investment pricing.

output.verdict: Canva's disclosed user scale, named enterprise adoption and subscription model make it a credible scaled-software opportunity. Investment conviction requires reconciling revenue and ARR to audited accounts, testing AI unit economics, and ensuring restructuring, valuation and reporting-control risks are reflected in the entry price.

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
